statement: Human pluripotent stem-cell-derived skin organoids develop stratified epidermis, fat-rich dermis, pigmented hair follicles with sebaceous glands and Merkel-targeting sensory neurons over 4–5 months, and form planar hair-bearing skin when grafted onto nude mice.

measurement.assay: histology; single-cell RNA-seq versus fetal skin; grafting
measurement.effect: organoids equivalent to second-trimester facial skin; hair-bearing planar skin after grafting

replication.note: One group (Koehler). Human cells, mouse host: nothing grafted into a person.

provenance.method: manual reasoning from the cited sources' abstracts (PubMed) and Crossref metadata, checked 2026-09-11; no source opened at figure level
